headline: Value of pending tax cases in the courts equals the sum of some of the largest public investments
summary: Tax cases over €1 million pending in administrative and tax courts total €23.2 billion, about 8% of Portugal's GDP. The sum is nearly three times the estimated cost of the new Lisbon airport.
why: Large pending tax disputes represent potential government revenue that is uncertain and can take years to resolve, which matters for fiscal planning and public debt assessments.
